summary: The community highlights the significant roles of Monisha Kaltenborn and Peter Sauber within the Sauber Formula One Team, emphasizing Kaltenborn's historic appointment as the first female team principal in 2010.

key_statements.statement: Monisha Kaltenborn became the first female team principal at Sauber Formula One Team in 2010.
Peter Sauber was the former team principal and founder of Sauber F1.
